full_prompt_en: A square Romantic landscape oil painting looks out from beneath a vast dark rocky overhang toward a small sunlit valley and a turbulent sky. The cave-like ceiling hangs across the entire top edge, its broken underside almost black, and a craggy right wall narrows the opening. At left, a rough rock face and a leafy tree occupy the near shadow, with small pale patches of stone catching stray light. The open center reveals a winding earthen path running from the bottom foreground toward a distant strip of water. Low grass and scattered rocks flank it. A tiny roofed structure stands on the left middle slope, partly hidden among shrubs, while a darker wooded ridge rises on the right. Near the lower-right center, a shallow stream or pool curves through the valley, reflecting a pale break in the clouds. The far distance is rendered in cool gray and muted green, with low horizontal bands suggesting an open horizon beyond the narrow land passage. Above it, immense layered clouds fill most of the opening. Their pale cream edges catch a bright high light near the upper-right center, while heavy gray interiors make the sky dramatic and deep. Light enters through that opening and spreads across the central ground in warm green-gold patches, but the framing rocks and immediate foreground remain in rich brown-black shade. Fine brushwork models stone, foliage, and cloud folds, changing to softer atmospheric transitions at the horizon. The image contains no visible people and no legible text. The overall composition uses the dark natural arch as a powerful frame around a fragile illuminated route, balancing close rocky weight with distant air and sublime cloud light.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形浪漫主义风景油画从一块巨大的暗色岩石檐下望出去，看到小片受阳光照耀的山谷和翻腾天空。洞穴般的顶壁横贯整个上边缘，破碎的底面近乎黑色，右侧陡峭岩壁让开口变窄。左侧，粗糙石壁与一棵绿叶树占据近处阴影，少量浅色石面接住漏入的光。中央开阔处，一条弯曲土路从底部前景通向远处狭窄水面。低草与散落石块夹在两边。左中坡上立着一座小小有屋顶的结构，部分藏在灌木间；右侧则升起更暗的林木山脊。靠近右下中央，一条浅溪或水潭在谷中弯曲，映出云层里的浅色开口。远处以冷灰与低调绿色描绘，低矮水平色带暗示狭窄陆地通道以外的开阔地平线。其上，巨大的层叠云填满大部分开口。云缘的浅奶油色在右上中央附近接住高处明光，厚重灰色内部让天空充满戏剧感与纵深。光穿过云口进入山谷，在中央地面铺出暖绿金色斑块，框景岩石和最近前景却留在丰厚棕黑阴影中。细致笔触塑造石头、枝叶与云的褶皱，到了地平线则转为更柔和的大气过渡。画中没有可见人物或可读文字。整体构图以暗色天然拱顶有力框住一条脆弱受光的路线，平衡近处岩石重量、远方空气和壮阔云光。
style_prompt_en: The painting has a Romantic oil landscape finish built from a dramatic dark frame around a luminous atmospheric opening. Deep umber, charcoal, and olive-brown masses press inward, while cream cloud light, muted green-gold, and cool gray distance release the center. Rough close textures are formed with small layered strokes; distant passages soften into thin tonal bands. Strong high-side light outlines irregular edges and makes a few central planes glow, leaving the enclosing forms almost opaque. The composition moves from heavy upper and lateral borders through a tapering low route toward pale open space. Uneven natural contours contrast with a calm horizontal distance, producing pronounced scale and depth. The overall effect is contemplative and sublime, with light seeming to emerge from darkness.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有浪漫主义油画风景完成面，以戏剧性的暗色框架围住明亮大气开口。深棕、炭色和橄榄棕大块向内挤压，奶油色云光、低调绿金色与冷灰远景在中央释放空间。近处粗糙肌理由层叠小笔触构成，远处段落柔化成薄薄的色调带。强烈高侧方光勾亮不规则边缘，并让中央少量平面发光，包围形体则几乎不透光。构图从厚重上缘与侧边，经一条低位收窄路径通向浅色开阔空间。不齐的自然轮廓对照平静水平远景，产生明显的尺度与纵深。整体效果沉思而壮阔，光仿佛从黑暗中浮现。
theme_en: A sunlit valley viewed from beneath a dark rocky overhang
theme_zh: 从暗色岩石檐下望向阳光照耀的山谷
name: Carl Gustav Carus
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
